items.risk: utoipa-swagger-ui egress 403 (#2966) renders api-server structurally unbuildable in the cloud runner — every backend-touching dispatcher task is CLOUD-BUILD-BLOCKED, including all 3 open cross-tenant IDOR retries (#2944/#2945/#2946). Security fixes are not landing because the toolchain can't compile, not because the fix is hard
items.mitigation: Vendor swagger-ui assets locally OR allowlist the egress target OR cache the dist in the sandbox base image — any of three. Blocks: all backend security PRs plus #2559 / #2555 accounting trio
items.trigger: Any dispatcher run with claimable<=10 AND >=2 open blocked-on-#2966 items

items.risk: Cross-tenant IDOR #2946 (portfolio_analytics property metrics computed org_id then discarded) is on retry 2/2 and still open — a tier-1 security defect that has survived two implementer attempts; a successful exploit returns per-property metrics across org boundaries
items.mitigation: Prioritize #2966 unblock; if infra slips, land #2946 fix locally and push a reviewed PR by hand; add a hand-written cross-tenant repro test as part of the fix PR so regression surfaces
items.trigger: retry 2/2 failing without a merged PR; or dispatcher record of 3+ failed-no-pr cycles

items.risk: @ppt/api-client has triplicated auth-header + MFA-retry logic across fetch primitives (gdprClient, paymentMatching, remaining consumers) — surfaced by post-merge review of PR #3004 and tracked as #3006. Three copies will drift (one will forget to attach MFA-retry on a 403; one will send a stale token; one will log the token). Classic security-overtones refactor target
items.mitigation: Collapse into a single shared `authenticatedFetchJson` primitive; add a biome rule to forbid new fetch primitives that do not import from the shared module
items.trigger: Any new PR introducing a 4th auth-header path, OR an MFA regression caught post-merge

items.risk: Accounting MVP-loop trio (#2555 / #2558 / #2559) has been sitting at 64d with no reviewer engagement — dispatcher stack is still starving on reviewer capacity, not implementer capacity. Risk is now aging past the 'review by October' commitment captured in the sprint retro
items.mitigation: Explicit reviewer slot for the trio next 24h; document reviewer-slot rotation policy for large-scope feature PRs

items.risk: Layout publish webhook lacks timestamp/replay protection (#2485) — a captured legitimate publish can be replayed to overwrite a newer layout
items.mitigation: Fix #2485 (add nonce+timestamp+HMAC parity with esignature webhook); track integration test in action-list

items.risk: Mobile LAYOUT_CACHE_KEY is not tenant-scoped and survives logout (#2486) — user A's layout can leak to user B on shared device or org-switch
items.mitigation: Fix #2486 (namespace cache key by tenant_id + purge on logout); add regression test in QA action-list

items.risk: add_evidence dispute sub-resource remains cross-tenant-writable until PR #2490 lands (#2483) — PR #2450 fixed 5 handlers but missed the sub-route
items.mitigation: Land PR #2490 promptly; add subroute-authz regression as part of ongoing IDOR sweep pattern

items.mitigation: Replace pure-Rust model test with sqlx integration test that exercises the actual RLS policy

items.mitigation: Adopt eslint-plugin-react-hooks + i18next-hardcoded-strings ESLint config in frontend/apps/mobile; gate CI on it

items.risk: cargo-deny advisories FAILED on dev HEAD: RUSTSEC-2026-0368 / RUSTSEC-2026-0369 on zip 8.6.0 pulled transitively via rust_xlsxwriter (#3124). Every backend PR merge is now gated on this since the advisory gate is required. Compounds with #2966 (swagger-ui egress) that already blocks builds — now builds green PRs cannot merge either.
items.mitigation: Either bump rust_xlsxwriter to a version with safe zip transitive dep, or add a bounded cargo-deny exception for RUSTSEC-2026-0368/0369 with a deadline captured in dispatcher backlog and surfaced in CI gate description
items.trigger: cargo-deny advisories failing on dev at any point beyond 24h after advisory publication

items.risk: External-dependency drift surface: cargo-deny can veto every backend merge on any new RUSTSEC advisory landing on a transitive dep (today: rust_xlsxwriter → zip 8.6.0 → RUSTSEC-2026-0368/0369). Integration velocity collapses to zero on advisory bursts; no SLA on how fast exceptions get triaged.
items.mitigation: Introduce a bounded cargo-deny exception window with deadline tracked in dispatcher backlog; add CI gate description text that links the exception policy and names the current triage owner
items.trigger: Any cargo-deny advisory failure that is not resolved within 24h

items.mitigation: Spot-check api-validation.yml on PR #3122; if the generated client bump was not part of the merge, open a follow-up to regenerate

items.trigger: Any violations IDOR exploit reported, OR a 2nd add_evidence-shaped gap found in a different resource

items.risk: Issue #3168 — 3 new RUSTSEC advisories on dev gate every backend PR merge; this is the second cargo-deny gate in a month (#3124 cleared 2026-10-19). Dependency hygiene is becoming a recurring merge-queue tax
items.mitigation: Resolve #3168 (bump offending crate(s) or bounded exception); schedule a quarterly cargo-tree review of transitive deps with known-flaky lineage (zip/xlsxwriter were last month's culprit — look for recurrence)
